title: Automated compliance evidence bundles with residency-aware filters and periodic delivery
creator: Jordan Kim
description: Background: Customers in regulated industries (finance, healthcare, government) require periodic attestation packages and machine-readable evidence of compliance. Current ad-hoc exports are manual and brittle: support creates CSVs or PDFs on request and compiles evidence from multiple dashboards. Scope: deliver a first-class feature that produces tenant-scoped compliance evidence bundles (PDF + CSV + manifest) filtered by data residency and retention settings, with scheduled delivery options (email/S3/GCS/SFTP/webhook). Goals: 1) Provide per-tenant export templates that include audit logs, retention policy snapshots, data residency declarations, and sample request traces. 2) Allow scheduled recurrence (daily/weekly/monthly/custom cron) with timezone support and delivery retry semantics. 3) Ensure exports are signed, encrypted in transit and at rest, and recorded in audit logs for proof-of-delivery. 4) Surface export history and status in Console under Compliance -> Evidence Exports. Non-goals: live stream of token-level data, deep packet forensic artifacts, or building a separate reporting engine beyond the bundle generator.
acceptance_criteria: 1) UX: Admins can create an 'Evidence Bundle' template selecting sections (Audit Logs, Retention Snapshot, Residency Map, Request Samples, Model Versions, Eval Results) and choose output formats (PDF, CSV, JSON manifest). 2) Residency filter: template supports filtering artifacts by legal_region tag and dataset residency metadata. 3) Scheduling: templates support recurrence with timezone, retention of last N exports, and pause/resume. 4) Delivery: supports at least Email (secure link), S3, GCS, SFTP, and webhook with auth; each delivery attempt is recorded. 5) Security: files encrypted using customer-specified KMS when available; links expire; downloads require role-based permission. 6) Observability: each export generates events visible in Console and is queryable via the audit API. 7) Performance: generating a bundle for a 90-day window for a medium tenant (avg 500k events) completes within 30 minutes in dedicated path or is offloaded to background job with progress visible. 8) Tests: e2e test that triggers scheduled run, verifies artifact integrity (manifest checksum), and confirms delivery succeeded or appropriate error states are surfaced.
success_metrics: - Reduction in manual support requests for audits by 80% within Q2 post-launch. - 90% of scheduled exports complete successfully without manual retries. - Time to assemble a 90-day evidence bundle reduced from 6+ hours (manual) to under 30 minutes / background job with progress. - Customer satisfaction for compliance reporting feature >= 4.0/5 in feedback survey.
scope: Included: template-driven bundle composition, residency-aware filters, scheduling UI, delivery integrations (Email, S3, GCS, SFTP, webhook), encryption support with KMS, Console UI for export history, backend jobs with retry and DLQ. Excluded: ad-hoc interactive query tool for arbitrary token-level exports, PIII redaction tooling beyond configured retention filters, and building managed long-term storage for delivered artifacts.
out_of_scope: - Building a universal reporting engine or replacing existing analytics pipelines. - Handling customer-side archival after delivery (customers manage their S3/GCS buckets). - Providing forensic-level packet captures.
proposed_solution: Backend: New 'evidence-bundles' service that composes artifacts from existing subsystems: audit-store, retention-config service, model-metadata, request-trace index. Bundles are built as a staged job: prefetch, compress, sign, encrypt, store to temporary encrypted blobstore, then push to destination. A manifest JSON (signed) lists files, checksums, and applied filters (residency, time window). Console: Template editor + Scheduler UI (cron presets + custom). Delivery connectors implemented as adapters supporting retries and backoff; failures route to DLQ and create support tickets if configured. Security: integrate with customer KMS for envelope keys, include S3/GCS presigned link generation with limited TTL, ensure RBAC checks on download endpoints.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Beta internal customers, 2 weeks): deliver S3 and email delivery, basic templates (Audit Logs + Retention Snapshot), residency filter, and Console history. Phase 2 (GA, 4 weeks): add SFTP, GCS, webhook, KMS encryption option, admin RBAC enforcement, and SLA docs. Phase 3 (2 months after GA): customer feedback-driven additions: template library, per-template transformations, signed attestations (PDF cover sheet), and scheduled retention of generated artifacts in managed bucket (opt-in). Rollout will start with opt-in beta and 1:1 support for first 5 customers with enterprise needs.
dependencies: ENG-5372 (audit-store query performance) - must support export windowed scans
SEC-102 (KMS integration and key policy approvals)
